offering_description.value: Sells consumer cyber safety subscriptions, including antivirus, identity theft protection, VPN and password management, plus personal finance tools. Sold to individuals and families mainly online and through device makers, delivered as software and online services.

primary_products.value: antivirus software; VPN; password manager; identity theft protection; personal finance app

primary_services.value: identity monitoring; technical support; credit monitoring; fraud resolution

customer_segment.value: B2C: individual consumers and families buying security and identity protection

end_markets.value: consumer cybersecurity; personal identity protection; consumer personal finance

revenue_model.value: subscription: recurring fees for security and identity protection plans; interest or premiums: lending and fee income from its personal finance products

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: develops security software and online services, sold to consumers; service provider: provides monitoring and fraud support services to subscribers; financial intermediary: offers personal banking and lending products to consumers
value_chain_position.category: software / platform; service provider; financial intermediary

geography_served.value: global: customers in many countries across North America, Europe and Asia

specialization.value: related lines: consumer security, identity protection and personal finance products sold to the same consumers

distribution_channels.value: online: direct sales through company websites and app stores; partners / resellers: preinstalled or bundled offers with device and internet service providers; third-party retail: boxed and retail-sold software licenses at electronics and office retailers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: data privacy and consumer protection rules, financial lending rules for its finance products
